component.name: Argon Control Center
component.summary: Monitor and tune a Raspberry Pi in an Argon40 case
Monitore e ajuste um Raspberry Pi em gabinete Argon40

description.p: Argon Control Center is a native control center for Raspberry Pi computers in Argon40 cases. It detects the board and the case automatically and brings telemetry, cooling, overclocking and hardware settings together in one window.

ul.li: Live CPU, temperature, memory, disk, network and GPU telemetry in three dashboard styles
Fan curve editor for the Argon daemon, with profiles and manual control
Board-aware overclocking with a power-supply guard, a trial boot and a stability test
config.txt hardware options: I2C, SPI, UART, audio, camera and display detection
GPIO lab with a live 40-pin diagram and a serial and I2C console
KDE Plasma widgets, a terminal interface and a JSON output for scripts

description.p: Hardware access uses udev rules and groups; system files are changed through Polkit with a backup of the previous version.

O Argon Control Center é uma central de controle nativa para Raspberry Pi em gabinetes Argon40. Ele detecta a placa e o gabinete automaticamente e reúne telemetria, refrigeração, overclock e ajustes de hardware em uma janela.
